title: Hing Hoi นาฬิกากลไกอัตโนมัติ หน้าปัดเรืองแสงเหมือนหิ่งห้อย
description: รู้จัก Hing Hoi นาฬิกากลไกอัตโนมัติจาก Lamphu Atelier หน้าปัดลายระลอกน้ำ หลักเรืองแสง สำรองพลังงาน 72 ชั่วโมง ตัวเรือน 38 มม. (แบรนด์สมมติสำหรับเดโม)

concept.name: One Light, One Night (ไฟดวงเดียว)
concept.logline: A night shoot of one watch: the reader holds the only light, turns the watch part by part, and switches the studio off to see the twelve lume dots glow like fireflies.
concept.held_object: the Hing Hoi watch on a polished slate slab
concept.verb: shine (ส่องไฟ): move the key light; hold to charge the lume; release to see it glow
concept.phenomenon: light stored and given back: raking light across the stamped ripple dial, then photoluminescent dots glowing when the light goes
concept.ip_note: Original concept. The brand and the watch are the content's own fictional ones. No real watch brand names, marks, lume trade names or recognisable existing dial, hand or case designs.

ช็อตสุดท้าย

reasons.reading: A short product page whose reader wants to see the watch: beside keeps it lit on the right next to every section, text never covers it, and the spec table reads as a ledger while the watch stays in view.
reasons.contents: People come back to a product page for the specs, the FAQ and the price: a plain list lets them jump there.
reasons.folio: The page is a night shoot, so each running head names the shot (close-up, flipped, profile, lights out) next to the chapter's name; no invented facts.
reasons.arrival: The studio wakes as the page loads: the lume dots show first in the dark, then the key light rises with real load progress.
reasons.tags: The parts the content names (crown, rotor, lume dots, quick-release pin, the three straps) are labelled beside them on the watch.
reasons.sound: A soft movement tick and a quiet room tone add the one thing a photo cannot; offered, never forced.

cc0.role: softbox and umbrella reflections on polished steel and sapphire; low-intensity image-based light only (never the background)
tannin leather strap, tinted darker brown (หนังฟอกฝาด)

chapters.name: เปิดตัว
chapters.beat: Three-quarter hero: the watch lies on the polished slate slab in front of a dark green sweep; a strip softbox rakes from upper left, a cool rim strip outlines the case, and far behind the out-of-focus lamphu branch holds a few faint firefly points. On arrival the lume dots show first, then the key light rises with load progress.
chapters.interaction: Move the pointer (tap on touch) to move the key light around the watch: the ripple dial shifts shade and highlights slide over the polished flanks.

chapters.name: หน้าปัด
chapters.eyebrow: หยอดมือทีละจุด · สิบสองหลัก
chapters.beat: Macro on the dial: low raking light crosses the stamped ripples so the dark green comes alive in bands; the twelve dots read pale cream; the slim hands carry the same cream; depth of field falls off past the crystal edge.
chapters.interaction: Hold (long press on touch) to brighten the light on the dial and charge the dots; release and the light dips for a moment so the dots glow in proportion to how long you held.

chapters.name: หิ่งห้อย
chapters.display: พอไฟดับ หิ่งห้อยก็มาเกาะรอบหน้าปัด
chapters.beat: Lights out: the key softbox fades to off over about a second; the twelve dots and both hands glow yellow-green, the slate reflects them softly, and behind the watch the firefly points on the lamphu branch swell and pulse together in the same colour. Only a faint cool rim stays on the case edge so the frame keeps shape.

light_target.note: p95 comes from the lume, the rim edge and the bokeh: bokeh sprites must be large enough (soft discs 2-4% of frame height) to register in a 32x18 sample

chapters.name: กลไก
chapters.beat: The lights come back and the watch turns over on the slab: through the sapphire caseback the rotor engraved with lamphu leaves swings slowly with scroll, and the balance wheel beats at 4 Hz (eight ticks a second); jewels catch tiny red glints.

chapters.name: ตัวเรือน
chapters.eyebrow: 38 มม. · กันน้ำ 100 เมตร
chapters.beat: Table-height profile: the camera drops level with the slab; the polished flank holds a long strip highlight while the brushed top stays satin; the domed crystal's edge glints; the screw-down crown with its knurled edge sits sharp in focus.

chapters.name: สาย
chapters.eyebrow: หน้ากว้าง 20 มม. · ไม่ต้องใช้เครื่องมือ
chapters.beat: The leather strap slides off the lug on its quick-release pin; the camera rises to a top-down angle where the three straps lie in a row on the slab: dark tannin leather, five-row steel bracelet, FKM rubber.
chapters.interaction: Point at (or tap) a strap: the light swings onto it and its name appears beside it.

chapters.name: สเปก
chapters.eyebrow: ตัวเลขทั้งหมดในที่เดียว
chapters.beat: Catalogue shot: the watch, back on its leather strap, sits at a clean three-quarter, the most evenly lit frame of the page. As the reader scrolls the ledger, the light and a tag move to the part each row names (movement, case, crystal, crown, strap).

chapters.name: ใช้และดูแล
chapters.beat: Calm: the studio lights drop to a low soft level; the watch lies face up, the seconds hand sweeping smoothly; the dots hold a faint glow and the fireflies pulse slowly behind. Nothing else moves while the reader reads.

chapters.name: ประกันและราคา
chapters.beat: Wrap: the strip softbox switches off and one warm practical lamp is left, pooling amber light on the slab; the watch rests where it began, its twelve dots glowing faintly in the warm light while the fireflies settle. The set is back to its first frame, changed: what was cream is now glowing.

sound.notes: tick = the movement's soft beat, played eight times a second at a very low level only while sound is on; turn = a soft light-switch click on chapter change; grip/let-go = the light charging and the lume answer.

detail: 38 mm 316L steel case, 11.4 mm thick, 45 mm lug to lug: polished flanks, brushed top surfaces and a crisp polished bevel between them
slightly domed sapphire crystal (IOR ~1.77, thin transmission) with a faint violet anti-reflective tint and edge glints
deep green-black dial stamped with fine concentric water ripples (procedural normal map) whose sheen shifts with the light angle
twelve slightly domed hand-dropped lume dots and two slim tapered hands with lume: cream by day, yellow-green emission after charging
screw-down crown with a knurled edge
sapphire caseback showing a rotor engraved with lamphu leaves, a beating balance wheel and red jewel glints
20 mm tannin leather strap with visible quick-release spring-bar levers, edge paint and stitching

sweep.falloff: radial pool behind the watch, fading to near-black at the frame edges

branch.kind: procedural lamphu twig: narrow oval leaves in opposite pairs on thin stems, held by a small stand behind the sweep's curve

key.type: strip softbox (RectAreaLight or emissive card + directional for shadow)

practical.type: warm lamp, off until the last chapter

lights.shadow: one shadow-casting light (the key); soft contact shadow under the watch on the slab

lume.note: brightest right after the light goes, then fading slowly but never to zero (content: brightest in the first hour, readable all night)

fireflies.pulse: the whole branch pulses together, slow and soft; no visible loop (noise-modulated period)

movement.rotor: engraved lamphu leaves, swings with scroll velocity

straps: หนังฟอกฝาด
